text:
rachel_pm: OrbitMarket asked for a compact compliance bundle for their cloud marketplace listing. They only want the minimum artifacts: SOC excerpt, a one-page pen attestation, and a KMS/HSM statement. Need to confirm owners and upload method.

ops_miguel: Deadline?

orbit_partner_engineer: Legal needs it by EOD Monday. They prefer a single presigned tarball and a small manifest describing redactions and TTL.

rachel_pm: We can support that. Proposed artifacts: soc_controls_excerpt.pdf (redacted), pen_attestation_trustassure_signed.pdf (1p), kms_hsm_statement.txt, README_marketplace.txt, manifest.json.

compliance_amy: Redaction rules: remove private IPs, internal hostnames, and employee PII. SOC excerpt should include control headings + auditor name only. Pen attestation must include vendor, scope summary, and signature; no technical exploit detail.

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Evidence policy: external presigned links default TTL 72 hours. All artifacts must have an owner and a taxonomy tag `marketplace-evidence/v3`. Escalate to compliance@redwood.com for TTL > 90 days.

ops_miguel: I'll assemble and presign. Plan: create narnix_orbit_bundle.tar.gz, TTL=72h, owner=ops_miguel. I'll add a README that explains redaction and contact info.

orbit_partner_engineer: Presign is fine. They asked if we can include a short KMS sentence proving no key export and whether keys are HSM-backed.

compliance_amy: KMS text should be explicit. Example: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric Customer Master Keys (CMKs) in AWS KMS for service-level encryption of model artifacts. Customers may supply BYOK via our integration; Redwood never exports customer key material to partners or external vendors." Add note on audit logging and IAM scoping.

rachel_pm: Manifest format I'll accept: single JSON with fields artifact_name, items (list), owner, ttl_hours, redaction_status. Example snippet in README: 
```
{
  "artifact_name": "narnix_orbit_bundle.tar.gz",
  "items": ["soc_controls_excerpt.pdf","pen_attestation_trustassure_signed.pdf","kms_hsm_statement.txt","README_marketplace.txt"],
  "owner": "ops_miguel",
  "ttl_hours": "72",
  "redaction_status": "IPs/hostnames/PII removed"
}
```

ops_miguel: I'll tag objects with `marketplace-evidence/v3` and include object tag owner=ops_miguel. Presign command I'll use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/orbit/narnix_orbit_bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 259200` (72h).

orbit_partner_engineer: Perfect. Legal will check README and confirm copy. Please DM presigned link once ready.

rachel_pm: Action list: (1) compliance_amy produce attestation redaction, (2) ops_miguel assemble bundle + presign, (3) rachel_pm confirm README and DM link to partner. Target: deliver by 2025-09-08 17:00 PT.

compliance_amy: I'll post the redacted attestation here for quick review in ~90m.

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Don't forget to set object retention TTL in the manifest and to include contact security@redwood.com in README.

ops_miguel: Acknowledged. Will ping this thread when presigns are live. :rocket:
